alerts.name: Bo Nix

alerts.source: Yahoo lineup wire · Fri Aug 14 · 11:00 AM
alerts.impact: Precautionary, no board move — but the biggest ADP riser on your scout list now carries an ankle asterisk.

alerts.name: Tua Tagovailoa

alerts.source: Yahoo lineup wire · Fri Aug 14 · 11:00 AM

alerts.name: James Pearce Jr.

alerts.name: De'Zhaun Stribling

alerts.name: Kirk Cousins

alerts.name: Jayden Reed

alerts.name: Rachaad White

alerts.source: SI preseason injury report · Thu Aug 13 · 8:15 AM

alerts.name: Tucker Kraft

alerts.name: Kyler Murray

alerts.source: NBC player news · Thu Aug 13 · 7:45 PM

alerts.name: Jalen McMillan

alerts.source: Beat feeds · Thu Aug 13 · 4:45 PM

alerts.source: Sharp Football IR tracker · Sun Aug 9 · 8:00 AM

news.text: Tonight’s ins and outs: Tua debuts for ATL with Bijan and London (Penix held out, ACL); Malik Willis makes his first Miami start; Bo Nix held out entirely (ankle); Jayden Daniels sits — Mariota starts WSH; Baker held back, Browning (back) out, so Bazelak/Daniels QB the Bucs.

Texans believe backup QB Graham Mertz tore his ACL in Thursday’s opener vs the Chargers, per Schefter. Also: Anthony Richardson’s full line was 11/14 for 145 plus 53 rushing yards and a rushing TD (one INT, one lost fumble).
Falcons LB James Pearce Jr. suspended eight games — the headliner in a batch of Friday bans outlined by ESPN's Jeremy Fowler. Titans CB Nazeeh Johnson got six games under the PED policy.
news.lean: Off the LB board in both leagues

news.text: De'Zhaun Stribling: 7 catches, 63 yards in one half vs Tennessee — the best offensive player on the field for SF. Steelers rookie Drew Allar threw two TDs and ran for another in his debut. Raiders' Mendoza led a TD drive, but Kubiak says the job is still Cousins' to lose.

Thursday's opener results: Bengals 16-14 Lions, Steelers 28-9 Packers, Patriots-Colts 13-13 tie, Chargers 27-7 Texans, Cardinals 27-14 Raiders, Titans 19-13 49ers. Tonight: DEN@ATL, MIA@WSH, TB@NYJ (all 6 PM CT).

Preseason Week 1 fallout: Jayden Reed (boot, unrelated to toe) and Rachaad White (groin, day-to-day) headline the injury report. Rhamondre Stevenson also banged up. Jefferson, Waddle, Hill sat with minor issues — no concern.

Kyler Murray named the Vikings' starter over J.J. McCarthy. Rotoworld crew also debating whether Omarion Hampton's ADP has run too hot, and who leads Denver's backfield with J.K. Dobbins nursing a soft-tissue injury.
49ers signed Deebo Samuel Sr. after Pearsall's season-ending PCL surgery — Deebo slots in behind Mike Evans, pushing rookie De'Zhaun Stribling to WR3 with upside if either vet misses time.
Puka Nacua (psoas soreness, initially reported as groin) expected back at practice next week. McVay says he'll be ready to go — a short absence, outlook unchanged.
Saints rookie WR Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) left practice early with a trainer, per Mike Triplett. Same player who lost three games to a Grade 2 hamstring last fall — MRI pending.
news.lean: Pause the sleeper pick until the MRI

news.text: Emeka Egbuka left Bucs practice with a minor toe issue. Not considered serious — monitor like Nacua.
Alec Pierce (ankle) expected off PUP within a week — in line for Week 1. Daniel Jones (Achilles) still ramping; Adrian Martinez would see extensive preseason work if Jones sits.

UPDATE Aug 13 — Aaron Glenn says Sadiq will miss a couple of weeks; team hopeful for the season opener. Original: Jets rookie TE Kenyon Sadiq suffered a setback in his recovery from offseason hernia surgery and is expected to miss some time.
Puka Nacua exited Tuesday's practice with groin soreness that is considered minor — but he missed time in 2024, so there is history.
Malik Nabers practiced for the first time since his ACL tear and had been running routes before camp. Worst case now looks like missing a game or two; he is on track for Week 1.
Mahomes says the injured knee feels great and he is targeting Week 1. Andy Reid has not committed to preseason snaps.
49ers rule Ricky Pearsall out for the 2026 season after PCL surgery. Deebo Samuel Sr. signed to fill the room alongside Mike Evans and rookie De'Zhaun Stribling.
Isiah Pacheco sprained his MCL in Lions camp. Dan Campbell feels pretty good about him being ready for the start of the season.
Notable names on active/PUP: George Kittle, Brian Branch, Kerby Joseph, Nick Emmanwori, Zach Charbonnet, Micah Parsons.
Luther Burden III's early-August groin injury will push drafters to Odunze in the sixth round. Burden becomes the value pick later.
Mike Evans nursing a quad in his first 49ers camp. Shanahan: being smart with the soon-to-be 33-year-old; expected back for the season opener.
